user.title: Add NAS backup storage
user.description: Creates a native Supervisor backup location. For SMB, you can paste a Windows Explorer path such as \truenas\backups; it fills the NAS address and share automatically. SMB needs a share, username, and password; NFS needs an absolute export path.

data.windows_path: SMB path copied from Windows Explorer (optional)

error.invalid_mount_name: Use letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores for the name.
error.invalid_nfs_path: The NFS export path must start with /.
error.windows_path_cifs_only: A Windows Explorer path can only be used with SMB/CIFS.
error.invalid_windows_path: Enter a Windows network path starting with \.
error.windows_path_needs_share: Use a share path such as \server\share, not a subfolder.
error.mount_name_exists: A Supervisor mount already uses this name.
error.mount_failed: Home Assistant could not activate the mount.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not contact the Supervisor or NAS.

abort.supervisor_required: NAS Backup Storage requires Home Assistant OS or a supervised installation.
